Messages.Author: Zeymere
Messages.Body:
Who can bleed: Any ready minion. A minion cannot perform more than one bleed action each turn, even if they unlock.

OK I have 2 ready minions can each attempt to bleed? One at a time, One attempts resolves and then the other tries in the same turn?

I have 2 ready minions can one bleed my prey and different one bleed a different player if they have a Directed card or something that allows them?

To me the above rules seems to say each minion can attempt to bleed but that minion can only try once, move to a different minion wash rinse repeat???

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Zeymere wrote:
> OK I have 2 ready minions can each attempt to bleed?
>
Yes.

> Zeymere wrote:
> One at a time, One attempts resolves and then the other tries in the same turn?
>
Yes, you must fully resolve the first action before proceeding to the next.

> Zeymere wrote:
> I have 2 ready minions can one bleed my prey and different one bleed a different player if they have a Directed card or something that allows them?
>
Yes, they can bleed different Methuselahs, provided you have cards to do so (eg. Kindred Spirits or Night Moves)

> Zeymere wrote:
> To me the above rules seems to say each minion can attempt to bleed but that minion can only try once, move to a different minion wash rinse repeat???
>
Correct. A minion cannot bleed, unlock (with a Freak Drive for instance), and bleed again (even a different Methuselah).
